plugins.name: vaultmem
plugins.description: Four agent-memory skills split by job: vault-recall (check before you re-derive), session (cross-session working memory), vault-capture (write it down), vault-curate (what to write next / vault health) — namespaced vaultmem:vault-recall, vaultmem:session, vaultmem:vault-capture, vaultmem:vault-curate. Pairs with the vaultmem CLI.
